fields.Name: T177 - Sort Organizations Grid
fields.Description: Verifies that clicking the Name column header in the Organizations grid sorts the rows and visibly reorders the grid.

InputDefinition.goal: To open the 'Organizations' entity, use the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box - type 'Organizations' and click the node named EXACTLY 'Organizations'. Do NOT fight a group expand-chevron. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away. Once the Organizations grid is loaded, click the 'Name' column header to sort the grid by organization name. Success is reached when the Name column shows a sort indicator (an ascending or descending arrow) and the row order visibly changes to reflect the sort.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Organizations entity grid is open in the Data Explorer Data section
The 'Name' column header has been clicked and shows a sort indicator (ascending or descending arrow)
The grid row order visibly changes to reflect the applied sort
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
